name: Kimijima Yukari
source:
One of the few friends of Marie, Yukari is a fabulously rich woman and celebrity who often plays with the Mamiyas sexually, relieving her stress whenever she feels the urge. She has a perverse nature that's second only to Marie. [spoiler]A sadistic woman, Yukari enjoy owning several young male slaves which she often gets rid off when losing interest. She eventually will bid Makoto in the auction event and may become Sawatari's new Mistress should he fall to Marie's trap.[/spoiler]
